candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming ETH amount from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when the fallback accepts and updates state.
Remove the time ordering requirement so fallback no longer requires block.timestamp to be greater than pastBlockTime.
Change the assignment to record pastBlockTime as block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering stored value observed via the public variable.
Always transfer funds to the caller (remove the block.number % 15 condition), which changes whether balance is drained and thus can affect subsequent observable state.
Invert the block condition so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, changing when balance is sent and observable behavior.
